intent: Create a fast direct 3x3 hand-drawn storyboard of two siblings at a closed ferry terminal, then selectively refine failed cells if needed.

inputs.description: User-supplied image proving the two siblings, practical wardrobe, terminal geography, and grounded subject scale.
User-supplied black-and-white pencil and marker storyboard finish reference.

reference_assignments.use: identity, wardrobe, terminal geography, practical subject scale, and camera foundation
reference_assignments.ignore: exact pose, crop, final lighting arrangement, and photographic finish

reference_assignments.use: line weight, pencil and marker texture, paper grain, controlled gray wash
reference_assignments.ignore: identity, costume, location, action, props, and panel content

frames.story_moment: the empty terminal establishes the siblings' distance
frames.composition: terminal, bench, ramp, and both siblings remain geographically readable

frames.story_moment: both share the bench but avoid acknowledging each other
frames.composition: negative space separates sister screen-left and brother screen-right

frames.story_moment: the shared compass becomes the relationship trigger
frames.primary_action: the compass slides to a stop

frames.composition: profile with hand and compass still readable

frames.story_moment: the brother fails to complete the reach
frames.composition: sister foreground edge, brother and hand in midground
restrained face with terminal geometry retained

frames.story_moment: the unseen departure becomes the dominant absence
frames.composition: foreground railing and ramp preserve geography; no people

frames.story_moment: both characters remain present but no longer share attention
frames.composition: compass remains between them without hero framing

frames.story_moment: the sister has left and the decision remains
frames.primary_action: the brother sits partly obscured beside the untouched compass
frames.composition: empty bench space dominates frame-right; brother remains screen-right partial
